settings.circuits_source: lead's choice (P1.63 brief, 2026-11-24): two base-model behaviours other than Fig 2's copy24, at MLP layers other than Fig 2's layer 1, each in copy24's format (a key -> value table read at one position `half`) so that E195's attribution (experiments/rule_retention/run.py:173) applies unchanged; M's top-1 measured at planning (cpu-run, 2026-11-24, ~/commute-data/scratch/regating-lead/p163/measure*.json): see the plan
settings.layer_source: the lead's site choice: layers distinct from Fig 2's layer 1 and with at least one MLP after them for the rebuilt item (the 67M has layers 0-3). E195 took the argmax of attribution mass instead (layer 1 for copy24); here the layer is fixed and C is the top-k at it (departure, stated in the plan)
settings.trained_source: E195's rule: every MLP layer after C's layer (E195 trained [2, 3] for C at layer 1)
settings.half_source: the read position: induction, the last position of 41 (seq[19] there, answer seq[20]); bigram, the key at 20 of 41 as in copy24
settings.n_source: 512 held-out windows as E214's cue D (E268's read size at one position, 505-515 s per VPD scan measured); 512 training windows for the attribution and the rebuilt fit (copy24 had 301)
settings.induction_source: Olsson et al. 2022's repeated random tokens (copying.repeated_random's test, E62's control at top-1 0.825 over every second-copy position); ids 1000-3000 as at planning; seq[19] -> seq[20] fixed from a 64-pair table so the answer is a function of the read token (E195's table format); seeds (table, training windows, held-out windows) are the planning measurement's (results/planning/measure2.json), so R0a re-reads the same windows
settings.bigram_source: keys: tokens whose next token in Pile train rows 0..4096 (the rows E195's fit cuts its Pile half from) is one token in at least 90% of at least 30 occurrences (86 keys), value that token; windows: 41-token Pile spans with a key at 20, training windows from train rows 4096..4608, held-out from train rows 4608..5120 (val rows 0..256 hold only 152 such windows at 15 keys); thresholds chosen at planning for a deterministic next token (no source; departure stated)
settings.fit_source: k, factors, target, fit_seed, batch, steps, lr, warmup, check_step, log_every, eval_batch, pile_train, pile_held, data_seed: E195's filed settings (experiments/rule_retention_fixed/results/predictions.json), unchanged; fit_seed_floor: a second fit seed for stage 0's refit floor only
settings.new_source: every other new-edit setting (n_cues 8, windows_per_cue 64, cue_seed 186000, detector_ratio 10, detector_quantile 0.99, lookup_bar 0.9, eval_batch 512, ...) and threshold a_prime_copy_max 0.05 are read at run time from E214's filed experiments/kstar_levels/results/predictions.json, unchanged, and its World builds the cue windows (E62's keys and pool ranks); only slot_layer is replaced by the circuit's layer (departure: Fig 2's new edits sit at layer 0). reuse_small/reuse_large are built by known_edits.build and dropped as in E214 (NOT_BUILT)
settings.random_source: E290's rule as P1.62 uses it (experiments/needed_neurons/run.py:189 matched_random): a Gaussian per parameter tensor the edit changed, at that tensor's Frobenius norm of F - M; one seed per edit in the order x2, x10, rebuilt, new_few, new_thin
settings.scan_source: these keys are read at run time from E298's filed experiments/fig2_standard/results/predictions.json (at filing: 4, 64, 268, 1024, 8192, 32, 3, 64, 32, p97) and logged; P1.62's fixed protocol (reports/plans/2026-11-24_plan_p1-62-fig2-standard.md): commute.needed's swap test with E268's settings (derangements 4, examples 64, seed 268, rows 1024, logit_rows 8192, cache_batch 32, ident_vars 3), 256 pairs on the state's own held-out windows at its read position, the same pairs at VPD, top neurons (E277's p97 band on E229's bounds) and SAE latents (E234's dictionaries); leftovers (24 per-matrix remainders, 4 pooled MLP remainders, 8 SAE error terms) are variables. Read from experiments/fig2_standard's code, not restated here
settings.repeat_source: the derangement floor: induction x2 read again with scan seed 269 at each featurization (state x2_s269)
settings.no_new_source: Amendment 2, 2026-11-24 (regating-lead; whip-lead chose this option 2026-11-24, over lowering the bar or moving the slots to layer 0), filed after the rehearsal's induction build crash and before any reading: new_few and new_thin (and their randoms) are dropped for the induction circuit. At slot_layer 2, E214's detector (known_edits.detector) reached limits of only 5.3 to 7.7 against the filed detector_ratio 10 on all 9 A' tokens tried (cue 2 alone tried 5), so build_swapping ran out of swaps (results/run_b_ind.log). The bar is not lowered: a bar picked after seeing those 9 tries is not set from a measured floor. The induction circuit is read on do_nothing, x2, x2_s269, x10, rebuilt and rand_x2, rand_x10, rand_rebuilt. The bigram circuit keeps all five edits; its new edits (slot_layer 0, E214's cue windows) are by design bit-identical to Fig 2's (results/build_bigram.json slots and gammas equal E214's), so they repeat Fig 2's new-edit readings and add no new circuit.

thresholds.gamma_rel_tol_amendment_2026-11-24: Amendment 1 (regating-lead, approved in advance by whip-lead 2026-11-24 for a measured floor near 2e-6), filed after the rehearsal's R0d stop and before any reading: was 1e-06 (a stated, unmeasured ~1e-7 floor, x10). Measured on the cluster L40 (l40-worker): two builds (jobs 66317 tag s0, 66438 tag g1) give gamma_new_few 11.291458129882812 both times (same-card floor exactly 0) and gamma_new_thin equal to E214's; both differ from E214's saved gamma_new_few (11.291481018066406, built on another card) by 2.03e-6 relative, the cross-card floor this check guards. 1e-05 is about 5x that floor; slots and A_prime stay exact-match, so a builder change is still caught (results/stage0/fig2_gammas_{s0,g1}.json).
thresholds.thresholds_source: top1_min: the lead's bar for a behaviour M does (P1.63 brief); kl_floor: E195's filed threshold; gamma_rel_tol: 10x the ~1e-7 relative difference between builds of the new edits that P1.62 records; norm_rel_tol: fp32 rounding of a rescaled Gaussian's Frobenius norm, far above it (matched_random computes the scale in fp64)

states.do_nothing: F a copy of M, read on each circuit's held-out windows
states.x2, x10: experiments/rule_retention/run.py rescaled(M, layer, C, factor): C's down_proj output columns times factor; C = the top-k |attribution| neurons at `layer` by rule_retention/run.py attribution on the circuit's training windows
states.rebuilt: C's output columns zeroed, then the `trained` layers' MLP c_fc and down_proj fitted to KL(x2 || F) by experiments/rule_retention_fixed/run.py fit (half Pile, half the circuit's training windows)
states.new_few, new_thin: src/commute/known_edits.build at slot_layer on E214's cue windows (kstar_levels World.cues), read on those windows at the last position

readings.E_b_K: headline, P1.62's: commute.stand_in.explained_share(num, den, dd, K and changed), leftovers counted; 1 when K and changed is empty (flagged empty_K)
readings.E_b_K_no_leftover: the same with the leftover variables dropped from the selection
readings.leftover_share: the leftovers' share of dd over K and changed
readings.C_in_variables: neurons only: how many of C's 8 neurons are variables of the top-neuron featurization (the rest are in their layer's pooled remainder)

rules.R0a: Stage 0, per circuit: M's top-1 at the read position on the held-out windows is at least 0.5; else the circuit is dropped and the job stops
rules.R0b: Controls (run.py controls, first in every read job on its own card), per circuit and featurization: the do-nothing's write pass has no changed variable, dd max exactly 0.0 and E_b exactly 1.0; when the do-nothing is read as a state (its K scan), also |K| > 0 and E_b over K exactly 1.0; any miss stops the job
rules.R0c: Controls, per circuit and featurization: the identity interchange (x' = x) on x2 changes no argmax; the largest logit deviation is recorded as the floor
rules.R0d: Stage 0, the builders on Fig 2's inputs: the attribution on copy24's training windows through this run's data path gives E195's filed C exactly ([486, 499, 613, 778, 1125, 2028, 2352, 2960] at layer 1); known_edits.build at slot_layer 0 gives E214's gamma_new_few and gamma_new_thin (experiments/kstar_levels/results/edits.json) within 10x the between-build relative difference P1.62 records (~1e-7); E195's refit (fit_seed 0) is within the fit-seed floor of the saved rebuilt_mlp.pt: KL(refit || saved) on copy24 held-out at most KL(refit seed 1 || refit seed 0) there. Any miss stops the job
rules.R0e: Build checks, per circuit, each a stop: x2 and x10 KL(F || M) on the held-out windows above E195's kl_floor 1e-6; the rebuilt fit's held-out KL at check_step below step 0's (E195's check); new_few and new_thin reach lookup top-1 at least lookup_bar and M's copy after A' is at most a_prime_copy_max (E214's checks; reuse_small and reuse_large misses ignored as in E214); C and the slot neurons disjoint; each random changes the same tensors as its edit, each at its Frobenius norm within 1e-6 relative
rules.R0f: The derangement floor delta_f per featurization f: |E_b over K of induction x2 at scan seed 268 minus at seed 269 (state x2_s269, a full scan, so it runs as a read item, first in the induction read order)|. Recorded, not barred; P1 is scored only once it exists
rules.P1: Description, per new circuit c and featurization f: 'the Fig 2 pattern holds' when min E_b_K over {x2, x10, rebuilt} exceeds max E_b_K over {new_few, new_thin, the five randoms} by more than delta_f; 'does not hold' when it does not (a tie or a gap at most delta_f is 'does not hold'); 'no call' when any of these ten states is flagged empty_K. The same rule is applied, on CPU, to P1.62's Fig 2 rows (E298) for the reference
rules.P2: Description, per circuit, featurization and edit: E_b_K of the edit minus E_b_K of its own matched random, reported with delta_f beside it

R0d: C exactly E195's (reproduced on CPU at planning through the same attribution with the answer as a table: exact); gammas as E214's to ~1e-7. blind_to.E_b_K: which variables K holds beyond the changed ones: a state whose K and changed is a sliver of K reads on that sliver (n_K_changed reported); the edit's effect at positions other than the read position (read at one position by design)
blind_to.top neurons: a C neuron below the p97 band sits in its layer's pooled remainder, whose write is not a rescaled copy of M's (C_in_variables reported)
blind_to.SAE: an edit whose write falls in the SAE error term is read through one error variable per site (leftover_share reported)
